And that\'s everything you need to know! Why don\'t you add your first treatment? I\'m sure you\'ll do great! When you want to ask me to remember a treatment, press this button. Look, I\'m going to press it for you! For every time of the day you have to take this treatment, touch the + button and set a time. Here you have to tell me what you want me to call the treatment. If it is a very complicated name and you do not remember how to spell it, press the button on the right to show me a picture of the medicine box. Here will appear the treatments that you have told me to remember. If you have finished with any of them, you can delete them from here. Adding a name Adding a treatment Checking treatments Next Defining the capacity of the package How many items are in your medicine packet? 10 tablets? 25 sachets? Maybe it\'s a 200mL syrup? Whatever it is, write it down without fear! What\'s the size of your dosage? Here you have to tell me how many units a dose of your treatment consists of. Maybe it\'s just one pill, a 25mg scoop? I\'m all ears! Specifying a start date Whether you start the treatment today, in a month or even next year, let me know so I can put it in my diary! Specify frequency How often do you have your dose? I know the possibilities are endless, but I have them all in mind. Select specific days. If you don\'t want to be notified every day, just tell me the days I need to remember to notify you and I promise I won\'t miss a single one! If you feel like it, try playing one of the days now to familiarise yourself with the menu. Select a custom interval I get it, I\'m a pain and you don\'t want me to remind you of things all the time. Here you can tell me how many days, weeks or months you want to be reminded - I\'m not mad, really! Continue to specify times Whether it\'s 6 a.m., 10 a.m. or even 7.41 p.m., you\'ll never catch me asleep. Tell me what time to tell you and I won\'t be late for a single day! I\'ve never seen you before! How are you? Nice to meet you, I\'m Clover. I know you don\'t know me very well, but don\'t worry: I\'ll keep everything up to date for you! Seriously, I\'m very tidy, I don\'t miss a thing! But, before I forget, could you tell me your name? "Wonderful, " ! Now that we know each other, I\'m going to show you a bit of this! Follow me! Good morning! What a nice day today! Do you have any plans? Hello again! I love this time of the day, don\'t you? The sky looks so beautiful… Good morning! What\'s there for breakfast? I\'ve been seeing a lot of you around here lately - I\'m so glad you\'re so consistent! What, you thought I was sleeping while you were gone? I never sleep! Hi! What a nice day today! Do you have any plans? Howdy! Today I read that the oldest legal medicine in the world is Aspirin - it has been marketed for over 150 years! How\'s the day going? While you were gone I did 1000 push-ups! Remembering everything requires extreme preparation! Don\'t forget that I can look up nearby pharmacies for you in case a treatment is about to run out! There are medicines with endless names. If you get stuck on one, show me a picture and I\'ll try to write it down for you! Hello again! I love this time of the day, don\'t you? The sky looks so beautiful… \"The whisper of the dusk is night shedding its husk.\", how beautiful! Do you know any similar saying? Have you seen the sky? It turns red like this because it reflects the sunlight at sunset! Sometimes I think about what time the great artists chose to create their most beautiful pieces, and I\'m sure that this is it! My creator says that watching the sunset over the sea is one of the most beautiful things there is, but whenever he goes to see it, he always has me in his pocket! Good evening! Have you had dinner yet? Hoo, hoo… owls wake up at this time. Did you know that species with similar eye colours hunt around the same time? Can you imagine if 18 out of 24 hours of the day were spent at night? That\'s what happens in the Nordic countries in December! Did you know that? Sleep is such a luxury, which I can\'t afford… just don\'t forget to charge your phone\'s battery! Good night! Did you know that humans spend 25 years sleeping - that\'s a lot! Back Settings Permissions needed It seems you haven\'t given me permission to use your camera. So that I can read the name of your medicines, can you please give it to me? It seems you haven\'t given me permission to use your location. So that I can search for pharmacies near you, can you please give it to me? In order to keep your reminders up to date after a reboot, could you please allow me to start automatically? After clicking on Settings, go to Apps > App launch. Then look for Clover in the list, uncheck the blue toggle and press OK. CALL NOW Before you call, write down the name of the medicine and its capacity so that you don\'t forget it.
